articles.title: Florida battles historic flooding as storms move further north
articles.description: In Central Florida, residents face rising water levels from recent heavy rain, prompting evacuation alerts. Authorities urge those living by the St. Johns River to brace for potential evacuations as flooding disrupts Thanksgiving festivities. Emergency responders are tirelessly aiding those stranded in waterlogged neighborhoods, while meteorologists predict that both heavy rainfall and flooding risks will persist for the foreseeable future.

articles.title: Mexican cartel leaders, 19 others indicted in US over drug and arms trafficking
articles.description: In a significant legal move, a federal grand jury has charged leaders of the La Nueva Familia Michoacana cartel along with 19 associates. Key allegations against them include drug trafficking and weapons smuggling. Prominent figures Johnny Hurtado Olascoaga and Jose Alfredo Hurtado Olascoaga are on the run, purportedly using violence and bribery to grow their criminal empire and engage in human smuggling.

articles.title: After his wife Susan died, Warren Lewis learned her body cannot be donated to science because of this
articles.description: Susan Lewis's noble desire to donate her body to science was thwarted by a miscommunication. After her passing, her husband, Warren Lewis, tirelessly advocated for revisions to the university's body donation policy. This advocacy birthed a collaboration with Macquarie University, enabling weekend donations and ensuring that future donors' wishes are honored, despite bureaucratic hurdles. Susan's journey underscores the complexities surrounding body donations in Australia.

articles.title: KSET 2026 provisional result declared; 8,171 candidates qualify, check cut-off marks
articles.description: KSET result 2026: The Karnataka Examinations Authority has declared the provisional KSET 2026 results, with 8,171 candidates qualifying against 7,204 available slots across 37 subjects. The examination was held on October 11, with 1,17,638 candidates appearing out of 1,29,214 registered applicants. The results follow UGC guidelines and Karnataka's reservation policy. Candidates can check subject-wise and category-wise cut-offs on the KEA website. The authority has announced that certificates will be issued to eligible candidates shortly.

articles.title: NMC proposes easing licensing rules for foreign medical graduates; DGHS approves stipend parity at five institutes
articles.description: The National Medical Commission has proposed easing licensing requirements for Foreign Medical Graduates through draft amendment regulations for 2026. The proposal seeks to replace the existing licensing eligibility condition with registration under the professional regulatory body in the country where the medical degree was awarded. The NMC has invited public suggestions and objections. Separately, the DGHS has approved stipend parity for FMG interns with Indian graduates at five government medical institutions.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' day 16: Ranbir, Yash film maintains strong hold; earns Rs 16.30 cr on Friday
articles.description: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend maintains strong box office performance, earning Rs 16.30 cr in its third week. The film's total India net collection has reached Rs 880.05 cr, with a worldwide gross of Rs 1,574.60 cr. Hindi screenings remain the biggest contributor, while Malayalam recorded the highest occupancy at 45.1%. The theatrical run has seen impressive ticket sales, totaling over 35 million sold.

articles.title: 'Johny Walker' actor Robin Varghese passes away at 56 in the US
articles.description: Actor Robin Varghese, recognized for playing Shelly in the film 'Johny Walker', has passed away at 56. He died in the United States on November 19, leaving behind a legacy in Malayalam cinema. Varghese began his career with Cochin Chorus and gained fame in the 1992 film alongside Mammootty. His last appearance was in the 2019 film 'Solamante Manavatti Sophia', directed by M. Sajeesh.
